translations.web: But he spoke all the more, “If I must die with you, I will not deny you.” They all said the same thing.
translations.bsb: But Peter kept insisting, “Even if I have to die with You, I will never deny You.” And all the others said the same thing.
translations.kjv: But he spake the more vehemently, If I should die with thee, I will not deny thee in any wise. Likewise also said they all.
translations.asv: But he spake exceedingly vehemently, If I must die with thee, I will not deny thee. And in like manner also said they all.
